title: Fleet Frenzy
subtitle: Deploy your fleet. Outsmart your rival.
description: Classic 10×10 Battleship against three bot difficulties: Cadet, Captain and Admiral. Arrange five ships, hunt the rival fleet and keep firing after a hit. Sink all 17 enemy ship cells to win.
controls: Drag ships to place them; tap or R rotates. S shuffles. Enter starts. Select a rival tile, then tap it again, press Enter or choose BLAST to fire. Escape pauses. Landscape touch supported.
headline: Deploy your fleet.|Rule the ocean.
heroDescription: Choose your rival, position your ships and read the ocean. A hit earns another shot. Sink the rival fleet before yours goes under.
caption: FLEET FRENZY · BY KARAS

presentation.note: Free to play. Progress lasts for this visit.

replayDescription: Local single-player matches against AI. In-memory progress resets on reload. No cloud saves, Myelin replay verification or CKB settlement.
